svg.title: Draw it: one network, four blocks
svg.desc: A large empty dashed frame for the student to draw in, with three instructions underneath: draw two inputs, sixteen hidden units and one output with the wires between them; put a chip on each bundle of wires with its shape written on it; and write the four block counts and the total in a box of its own, which should be 32 plus 16 plus 16 plus 1 equals 65.
svg.text: Draw it: one network, four blocks
1. two inputs, sixteen hidden units, one output — and the wires between them
2. a chip on each bundle of wires with the shape written on it
3. the four block counts, and the total, in a box of its own
